integrity: The counting law is derived analytically from the published fiber dispersion. Symbolic and numerical checks are corroborative only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result counts only the unique straight-line guided fiber branch per unit tangential length, not the full two-dimensional bulk or local density of states. It assumes nonzero mass and noncritical nonzero electrostatic coupling; criticality is taken as a limit.
title: Exact in-gap guided-state crowding law at the critical Dirac line shell
